state.query: What metrics (income, assets, consumption, GDP per capita) are used to compare wealth per capita across African populations?

candidates.title: The Changing Wealth of Nations 2024 - World Bank Group
candidates.snippet: The World Bank 2024 Changing Wealth of Nations (CWON) report offers a comprehensive view of a country's wealth by accounting for natural and human capital, complementing traditional GDP measures.

candidates.title: How to Measure a Country's Wealth: GDP, PPP and More
candidates.snippet: How rich is a country? The answer depends on what you measure. A nation’s yearly output, the income its residents earn, the assets it has built up, and the living standards of its people are four different things, and each ranking tells a different story.

candidates.title: Assessing comparative asset-based measures of material wealth ...
candidates.snippet: In the last decade, researchers have proposed a number of asset-based measures that permit global comparisons of household wealth across populations in different countries and over time.
